blocks_9: Narrow layouts truncate identities and spend almost 39% of a 760pt window on navigation.
The long-draft composer shows a clipped preceding text line and a weak scroll indicator.
Useful secondary information is repeatedly set at approximately 11-12pt, with insufficient typographic separation in dense dialogs.
Meeting detail, calling explanation and recipient selection need clearer action hierarchy.
Scroll cues, attachment identity and hover treatment still need refinement.

top_issues.issue: Narrow layouts reserve too much width for navigation while clipping identities and compressing content.
top_issues.evidence: At 760px, rail plus sidebar ends at x=295, taking 38.8% of the width. Calls names occupy roughly x=128..222 before call icons at x=233 and 267; Katherine Jo..., Dorothy Vaug... and Margaret Ha... are visibly truncated.
top_issues.fix: Below 800pt, offer a 64pt rail plus collapsible conversation list; in Calls put audio/video actions on a second line or reveal them on row focus, preserving at least 150pt for names.

top_issues.issue: The scrolled long draft has a visibly clipped preceding line at its top edge.
top_issues.evidence: Editor rectangle is approximately x=394..1250, y=552..760. Text fragments appear near y=559 above the first fully legible SELECT column_111 line at y=575. The scrollbar thumb is only around x=1166, y=728..752.
top_issues.fix: Keep an 8pt inset above the text clipping region and clip partial rows cleanly; place a visible 4pt scrollbar in a dedicated gutter spanning the editor viewport, with a minimum 24pt thumb.

top_issues.issue: Too much useful information uses the smallest secondary type tier.
top_issues.evidence: Native images show main conversation text around 14pt, with 11-12pt rail labels, timestamps, helper text, account emails and shortcut hints. For example chats composer help occupies approximately y=774..784 and account-menu emails y=363..371. These are screenshot estimates, not source font measurements.
top_issues.fix: Use 13pt for helper sentences, account emails and result previews, with 18pt line height; reserve 11pt for short uppercase category labels and 12pt for timestamps.

top_issues.issue: Search focus and the primary action identify different people with insufficient separation.
top_issues.evidence: Selected Grace Hopper chip sits near y=184; highlighted Barbara Liskov result spans y=282..326; bottom orange CTA at y=477 says Chat with Grace Hopper. The two strong targets compete.
top_issues.fix: Group selected people in a labelled Recipients section with 16pt separation from search results; use a stable Start chat CTA with an adjacent recipient count, preserving the selected result marker.

top_issues.issue: The scrollable settings viewport gives a weak cue that more content follows.
top_issues.evidence: Modal spans approximately y=49..722. Last visible checkbox is at y=672 with only a faint fade around y=695; scrollbar thumb runs y=117..455, well above the viewport end.
top_issues.fix: Reserve 16pt bottom padding plus a consistent 16pt scroll fade, or a small More settings below cue; keep a visible scrollbar track to the viewport bottom.

top_issues.issue: Meeting time and joining deserve stronger emphasis than organizer metadata.
top_issues.evidence: At 1280px, time is a secondary line at y=35 and Join is a roughly 66x32px control at the far right. Organizer/Online metadata occupies a 720x100px card at x=394, y=78.
top_issues.fix: Put an 18pt meeting-time line and 36pt-high Join action together in the detail content; render organizer/online as a compact 48-64pt metadata group below.

top_issues.issue: Opening whitespace and repeated meeting events consume disproportionate conversation height.
top_issues.evidence: In the 380x800 call-bar screenshot, header ends at y=132, beginning-of-conversation text is near y=247 and the first actual message starts near y=360. Date and meeting-event labels add separate rows at approximately y=288,322,598,635,669.
top_issues.fix: Reduce the opening inset to 24-32pt and combine each date with its meeting-start event into one compact 28pt row; retain the bottom-anchored composer.

top_issues.issue: Uniform attachment tiles make extreme-aspect images difficult to identify.
top_issues.evidence: Three approximately 144x96px tiles start near x=408,560,712. The 3072x256 and 256x3072 images reduce to a tiny horizontal strip and vertical strip; labels show only dimensions.
top_issues.fix: Add a 13pt filename or short attachment label, retain dimensions at 12pt, and offer a visibly labelled Preview action so the thin strip is not the only identity cue.

top_issues.issue: Hovered message treatment is heavier than needed and competes with persistent semantic highlights.
top_issues.evidence: In chats, hover background spans approximately x=382..1258, y=330..487 and includes a roughly 172x40px toolbar; group-chat adds a full-width peach mention band immediately above a grey hover band. The centered pointer explains the hover, so this is not treated as a stuck-state defect.
top_issues.fix: Keep the hover state but limit tint to the message content area, use 8pt row insets, and reduce the action bar to 32pt height; preserve the mention accent stroke as the strongest row-level marker.

top_issues.issue: Explanatory copy visually outweighs the main calling task.
top_issues.evidence: In calls-narrow, Join panel ends near y=174, while the How calls work section and capability rows occupy roughly y=201..375; the paragraph alone takes five lines.
top_issues.fix: Use one 13pt summary sentence under Join, then put detailed explanation behind the existing Details disclosure; keep recent-person actions prominent.

top_issues.issue: Technical setup and permission details are insufficiently separated from the plain-language task.
top_issues.evidence: Setup shows tenant hint over two short lines around y=450..473 and a second save explanation around y=575. Permission dialog includes a two-line Permission: Chat.Create paragraph beneath browser-consent copy.
top_issues.fix: Use 14pt task instructions with 20pt leading; present technical IDs/scopes in a compact 12pt detail row or disclosure and remove repeated explanatory sentences.

top_issues.evidence: At 1280px, left-column keycaps begin around x=200 while their descriptions begin around x=386, creating a broad gap for short keys; multi-key rows occupy much more of that space.
top_issues.fix: Use consistent 160pt key and flexible description columns, with 16pt separation and 32pt row height; align category labels to the same column starts.

top_issues.issue: Preview controls and image identity have little prominence in the large overlay.
top_issues.evidence: Overlay occupies nearly the entire 1280x800 window while Fit/100% controls are roughly 12pt at top left and identity is only 3072x256.
top_issues.fix: Use 13pt labels in 32pt-high Fit/100% controls and display a 14pt filename beside the preview title, with dimensions at 12pt.

top_issues.issue: Orange performs several unrelated semantic jobs, weakening distinction between attention and selection.
top_issues.evidence: Light #a5500f and dark #e88c3e appear on navigation selection, unread time/dot, account unread badge, reaction selection and primary action treatments. This is a semantic-overload finding, not a measured contrast failure.
top_issues.fix: Keep orange for primary actions and selected navigation; use bold 13pt neutral text plus the unread dot for unread time, and a neutral outlined reaction selection with a distinct check marker.

top_issues.issue: The visible hover tooltip overlaps the lower authentication card.
top_issues.evidence: In both supplied states the Use a code instead tooltip extends rightward and covers part of the divider/App registration area below the button row. Pointer placement explains its presence.
top_issues.fix: Place the tooltip above the fallback button with an 8pt offset and maximum 260pt width; keep it out of the next card section.
